human_reactome.pw

Reactome pathways for human (1,867 gene sets, NCBI Entrez gene IDs), taken from
the Molecular Signatures Database (MSigDB) v2026.2, collection C2:CP:REACTOME,
file c2.cp.reactome.v2026.2.Hs.entrez, and written in MAGMA set-annotation format
(usable directly with magma --set-annot): one pathway per line, the pathway
ID followed by its member genes, tab separated.

Licence: MSigDB gene sets are distributed under the Creative Commons
Attribution 4.0 International License (https://www.gsea-msigdb.org/gsea/msigdb_license_terms.jsp).
Copyright (c) 2004-2026 Broad Institute, Inc., Massachusetts Institute of
Technology, and Regents of the University of California.

When you use this file, cite MSigDB and Reactome.

Load in R with: catfish_load_pathways(species = "human_reactome")
or use the path directly: catfish_pmn_file("human_reactome")
